# Atelier

> Atelier is a self-hosted AI workspace with Chat and Code, on the models you choose: local (Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio) or hosted (Anthropic, OpenAI, Mistral, GitHub Copilot, OpenRouter, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint). It runs as desktop apps for macOS, Windows and Linux, as a web app you host with Docker, and as a terminal app, all on one backend. Source-available under the PolyForm Noncommercial license (free for noncommercial use). No telemetry.

Atelier is an independent project, not affiliated with any model provider. The website is atelierhq.dev, the documentation docs.atelierhq.dev and the source github.com/TheOriUHD/atelier.

## Start here
- [Download](https://atelierhq.dev/download/): desktop apps, the terminal app and the Docker server
- [Get started](https://docs.atelierhq.dev/getting-started/): install, connect a model, first conversation
- [Documentation](https://docs.atelierhq.dev/): every feature, the settings and the self-hosting guide
- [Documentation for language models](https://docs.atelierhq.dev/llms.txt): an index of the documentation pages in Markdown, and [the whole documentation in one file](https://docs.atelierhq.dev/llms-full.txt)

## Compared with other apps
- [All comparisons](https://atelierhq.dev/compare/): Atelier next to Open WebUI, LibreChat, LM Studio, AnythingLLM, Jan and Msty
- [Atelier vs Open WebUI](https://atelierhq.dev/compare/open-webui/): How Atelier and Open WebUI differ: licence, desktop apps, coding mode, accounts and models.
- [Atelier vs LibreChat](https://atelierhq.dev/compare/librechat/): How Atelier and LibreChat differ: licence, desktop apps, agents, code execution and accounts.
- [Atelier vs LM Studio](https://atelierhq.dev/compare/lm-studio/): How Atelier and LM Studio differ: running models versus using them, licence, servers and coding mode.
- [Atelier vs AnythingLLM](https://atelierhq.dev/compare/anythingllm/): How Atelier and AnythingLLM differ: documents versus coding, licence, telemetry, desktop and Docker.
